hints.title: Lookup Structure by Reversed Value
hints.text: For each element, store the most recent occurrence index of its reversed digit representation.

hints.title: Reverse Function
hints.text: Write a helper that reverses the digits of an integer: int(str(x)[::-1]).

hints.title: Single Pass Scan
hints.text: As you iterate through nums with index j, check if nums[j] exists in your lookup table. If present, update the minimum index difference j - last_seen[nums[j]]. Then register rev(nums[j]) with index j.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Here n is the length of nums and d is the average number of digits per element.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all index pairs (i, j) with i < j takes O(n^2 * d) time which exceeds the time limit for large arrays.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Using an auxiliary hash map stores O(n) reversed values and reduces search time from linear to constant.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects a single-pass hash map solution handling digit reversal correctly in linear time.
